ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) pixel distribution exceeding 95% of the total visible surface; high-intensity (white) pixels are confined to localized focal clusters and linear disruptions.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Solid low-intensity (black) base layer spanning both lobes; spatial distribution of high-intensity (white) clusters is concentrated at the lateral tips and distributed sporadically across the medial surfaces.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Central U-shaped depression with an approximate pixel-calculated interior angle of 70 degrees; depth occupies roughly 10-12% of the vertical lobe axis.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, high-amplitude serrations (peaks and valleys) along the superior boundary of both lobes; prominent irregular indentation located approximately 75% along the right lobe's span towards the tip.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex quadratic sweep fitted to the trailing edge, tapering to acute lateral points (tips) at the terminal ends.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Presence of approximately 40-50 circular high-intensity pixel clusters (scars) ranging from 5 to 15 pixels in diameter, heavily clustered at the far left and far right lobe extremities.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Distinct white linear pixel disruptions on the left lobe, oriented diagonally (approx. 45-degree angle) across the medial-lateral plane; additional horizontal linear marks visible near the central notch.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant scarring pattern including both circular (rosette) and linear (rake-like) high-intensity marks against a dark pigment field; notable irregular notch on the superior trailing edge of the right lobe.
